data.title: Kaleon: Buy Rating Backed by Strategic Lake Maggiore Acquisition to Build Integrated Tourism Platform
data.description:
Alessio Olmi, an analyst from TP ICAP MIDCAP, maintained the Buy rating on Kaleon S.p.A.. The associated price target is €5.50.

Alessio Olmi has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, starting with Kaleon’s strategic move to deepen its presence along the visitor journey through the acquisition of an 80% stake in the Lake Maggiore passenger transport operator. This transaction strengthens Kaleon’s transition from a heritage-site manager to an integrated tourism platform capable of internalizing more stages of tourist spending.

The valuation of the acquired business, at an EV of about €2.0mn for expected 2025 sales of €0.8mn, appears attractive relative to Kaleon’s scale and supports earnings accretion over time, particularly as consolidation progresses beyond 2026. While the initial financial contribution is limited, the deal bolsters diversification, opens scope for bundled offers for tour operators, and is expected to be slightly supportive for margins, underpinning the positive view on Kaleon’s medium‑term growth and profitability profile.

data.description:
Fiera Capital A, the Financial sector company, was revisited by a Wall Street analyst yesterday. Analyst Etienne Ricard from BMO Capital maintained a Hold rating on the stock and has a C$5.00 price target.

Etienne Ricard has given his Hold rating due to a combination of factors related to Fiera’s fundamentals and risk profile. Persistent net asset outflows across both PineStone-sub-advised and other public market strategies signal ongoing challenges in generating sustainable organic growth, even as PineStone’s share of total assets continues to decline.
